name: BiForge P84 curated context gold set
reviewPolicy: These are expected relevant files for read-only analysis scenarios, not exhaustive runtime dependency truth. A BiForge maintainer must confirm or revise them before any regression gate is enabled.

scenarios.description: Trace the Expert Mode brief/conversation UI and identify the likely caller, attachment, conversation-state and focused-test context.
scenarios.reviewNote: P82 split changes the target module; the scenario intent and dependency gold set stay fixed across revisions.

scenarios.description: Review a Project Mode HTTP route, its authoritative contract, persistence and compatibility/security context.
scenarios.reviewNote: Gold set deliberately includes API contract, persistence, composition root, migration navigation and regression tests.

scenarios.description: Trace task-state transitions across services, persistence, state machines and relevant tests.
scenarios.reviewNote: The gold set distinguishes static service links from persistence and test evidence that may not be imported directly.

scenarios.description: Trace database configuration and determine which environment names and migration evidence are relevant.
scenarios.reviewNote: Environment and migration inventories are navigation aids; runtime deployment configuration still needs manual confirmation.

scenarios.description: Find the source and verification path for the generated route inventory artifact.
scenarios.reviewNote: Expected known limitation: generated JSON-to-generator relationships are not inferred by the current static TypeScript import planner.

scenarios.description: Investigate a localized compatibility-route defect without loading the entire server composition root by default.
scenarios.reviewNote: P82 moved the target to a focused module; the composition-root integration points and route behavior tests remain relevant.
